title: Zero cohomology fractions imply tensor-power annihilation
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], L and F be O_X-modules, s a global section of L, and p a nonnegative integer. Use tensor powers and section multiplication from [def-sc-cohomology-fraction-presentation] and module cohomology from [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. If the additive degree-zero fraction presentation CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p top is a subsingleton, then for every xi in H^p(X,F) there exists e >= 0 such that the cohomology map induced by F -> F tensor L^{tensor e}, f -> f tensor s^e, sends xi to zero. No affine open, compactness, quasi-separatedness, invertibility, quasi-coherence, or positive-degree hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Use nonempty_moduleCohomology_top_iso to identify scalar-forgotten global module cohomology naturally with open module cohomology at top. Map xi through the comparison and then through the inverse right unitor to a numerator eta in degree zero.

Prove the zero and associativity identities for tensorPowAddIso by induction on the first exponent and monoidal coherence (reusing the proved private helper arguments in InvertibleSectionRing). The existing tensorPowAddIso_inv_app_tmulSection proves the product identity for section powers via unitHomEquiv. These identities give the identity and composition laws for mulTensorPowSection. Include the cast from i + (j - i) to j to obtain transition maps indexed by i <= j; applying open module cohomology gives a DirectedSystem.

DirectSum.toAddMonoid maps each summand to AddCommGroup.DirectLimit.of. By of_f it kills every defining fraction relation, hence also their AddSubgroup.closure. QuotientAddGroup.lift therefore descends it to the fraction presentation. Subsingletonness makes the class [0, eta] zero and applying the descended homomorphism makes its direct-limit class zero. Apply AddCommGroup.DirectLimit.of.zero_exact to obtain a transition that kills eta. Only a map from the quotient to the direct limit is needed, not an isomorphism of presentations.

The existing rightUnitor_inv_app and mulTensorPowSection_app_tmulSection identify the degree-zero transition composed with the inverse right unitor with F -> F tensor L^n, f -> f tensor s^n. A cast lemma proved by equality elimination handles 0 + n = n. Apply functoriality and the naturality of the comparison from step 1; its component is injective because it is an isomorphism. The desired global module cohomology class is therefore zero.

theorem exists_tensorPowSection_cohomology_eq_zero_of_subsingleton_fractions
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (L F : X.Modules) (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (p : ℕ)
    (hsub : Subsingleton (CohomologyFractionPresentation L F s p ⊤))
    (xi : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj F) :
    ∃ e : ℕ, (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).map
      ((ρ_ F).inv ≫ F ◁ tensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L s) e) xi = 0
